title: A Tentative Formulation of a General Law of Interpersonal Relationships
coreMove: Trace a relationship outcome back to the conditions of congruence and understanding that either opened or closed it.
sourcePressure: Rogers formulates a broader relational principle from the recurring dynamics of congruence, understanding, defensiveness, and growth. No split source sidecar exists for ch18; frozen TOC and book skeleton support the heading, part placement, and broad intent only, with no chapter-local named anecdotes, studies, or places.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Turning a tentative law into a rigid formula or universal guarantee.
sourceAnchorNote: The frozen source exposes no usable chapter-local named person, study, institution, place, date, or anecdotal artifact from Rogers here. Use fictional protagonists only; do not invent named Rogers cases or studies.

hook: opening with a definition of general law
